# RPi3 Boot Hang Handoff (2026-07-13 - Updated)

## Root Cause Identified
`spin::Once` uses `compare_exchange` (LDXR/STXR on AArch64) to transition from `Incomplete -> Running -> Complete`. On RPi3 hardware, these exclusive load/store instructions can fail spuriously due to AXI bridge limitations between ARM and VideoCore, causing the `compare_exchange` to loop forever waiting for success.

This is the same issue that exists in QEMU for `SpinLock`, which already has a workaround using `swap` instead of `compare_exchange` (see `ostd/src/sync/spin.rs:127`).

## Solution Implemented
Custom `SimpleOnce<T>` using atomic `swap` semantics instead of `compare_exchange`:
- `AtomicU8` with `Acquire` for loads, `Release` for stores
- Simple load-check-store pattern without compare-exchange loops
- Trade-off: loses panic recovery and Running state, but acceptable for single-threaded boot

## Commits on aarch64_support
- `0fca6e08`: Replace spin::Once with SimpleOnce using atomic swap
- `e4ce86ff`: Add TEST_ONCE to isolate spin::Once hang
- `0accd178`: Add debug markers to init_after_heap()
- `67a515c5`: Revert SimpleOnce, restore spin::Once (before realizing spin::Once was the issue)
- `0d76c2b0`: Original SimpleOnce work (before revert)

## Key Files Changed
- `ostd/src/boot/mod.rs`: `SimpleOnce` implementation, `init_after_heap()` with TEST_ONCE
- `ostd/src/arch/aarch64/boot/mod.rs`: Uses `crate::boot::SimpleOnce` for `DEVICE_TREE`

## Debug Markers in init_after_heap()
```
[IAH] START
[IAH] TEST_ONCE start
[IAH] TEST_ONCE inside   <- if this prints, SimpleOnce works
[IAH] TEST_ONCE done
[IAH] got EARLY_INFO
[IAH] before INFO.call_once
[IAH] inside INFO.call_once  <- heap allocation happens here
[IAH] done
```

## If Hang Occurs
- Before "TEST_ONCE inside": SimpleOnce itself hangs (unlikely)
- Before "inside INFO.call_once": spin::Once or something else hangs
- In closure: heap allocation issue

## Build & Deploy
```bash
# Build
docker run --rm -v /home/snow/asterinas:/root/asterinas asterinas/aarch64-dev:latest bash -c \
  'PATH=/root/asterinas/.docker-cargo/bin:$PATH cargo osdk build --release --target-arch aarch64 --boot-method qemu-direct --scheme aarch64'

# Deploy to RPi3
cp target/osdk/aster-nix/aster-nix-osdk-bin.qemu_elf /mnt/d/pi_sd/kernel8.img

# Serial monitor
stty -F /dev/ttyUSB0 115200 raw -echo && cat /dev/ttyUSB0
```

## T031 Status
QEMU AArch64 test output issue is separate - the serial output works on RPi3 but QEMU has stdin multiplexing issues. The QEMU scheme uses file-based serial output (`-serial file:/tmp/qemu_serial.log`).
